breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed the use of the bending second moment 'I = π d^4/64' for torsion calculations. The generated specification correctly omits this instruction and instead explicitly states to use the correct polar moment of inertia 'J = π d⁴ / 32', which aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
